Description:
My dear Henrick,
A most unsettling visitor arrived at my door last night. The man claimed he needed shelter from the cold, yet the moment I opened the door I understood his fear was not of the weather but of himself. His skin hung loose and gray in some places, stretched taut and translucent in others. His reed eyes were sunken yet fever-bright, darting in frantic circles even while the rest of him moved with a slow, deliberate caution. The faint smell of blood clung to him, but it was wrong… metallic, yes, but with a bitter, spoiled undertone I could not place.
He collapsed on my threshold, and when I helped him rise, he recoiled from my touch with a hiss not quite human. For a moment, his jaw shifted, stretching in a way no bone should, teeth lengthening before snapping back into place. His voice trembled between tones, sometimes hollow and airy, sometimes wet and guttural. He spoke of a hunger he dared not name, and of a “curse” that gnawed at him from within. I have seen vampires, lycanthropes, revenants, and plague-bearers, but never all their symptoms woven together in one trembling frame.
My friend… I believe he is one of the Hollowed. one of those unfortunate souls whose bodies have become host to curses that warp them beyond simple classification. A perfect, living specimen at last. I have sealed him in the cellar for now, where the stone is thick and the locks are strong; still, as I write this, I can hear him pacing beneath the floorboards, muttering in languages I do not know, scratching at the walls when he thinks I am asleep. I am eager to begin my treatment. And yet… I confess to you, my old friend, that for the first time in many years, I am very, very afraid.

Choose which race you were prior to your death.
This is only for aesthetics and storytelling purposes.

Creation.Stat Restrictions: Your Stat numbers are -2, -1, 0, 1 instead of -1, 0, 1, 2.

Stats.Size: the size of your past life race

Language: You speak Languages exactly how it says in the Race you were before death (see that Race's Languages box).

~Burden of Passing~.Effect:
Your starting Stats are -2, -1, 0, 1.
Your are always 1 Level higher than what you're supposed to be.
~Burden of Passing~.Upgrade: With your extra Level, you do gain Level Up bonuses for it, as normal.
~Burden of Passing~.Notes: e.g. if playing with Experience, even if you have gained enough Experience to be Level 3, you are Level 4, but still require Experience for Level 3 to 4 to Level up - and so on. If playing with milestone Levels, you are simply always always 1 Level higher than what you're supposed to be. Maximum Level is 10.
~Burden of Passing~.Name: ~Burden of Passing~

~Burning By Silver~.Effect:
You are a cursed individual. Your race can be any of the available ones for cosmetic purposes, but your curse makes your race's abilities inert, and only have what the Hollow race provides.
You take +50% Damage when hit by silver weapons.
~Burning By Silver~.Name: ~Burning By Silver~

Starting Abilities Description.Hollow:
A Hollow is an individual, of any previous race, who has been affected by a powerful curse or disease to the point where their old self, both flesh and mind, is no longer recognizable.
Be it vampirism, undeath, lycanthropy, or even being affected by a spirit curse, most Hollows seek a cure for their ailment, though some relish their afflictions, and are greatful not for the lack of humanity, but for the immortality granted by their curse.

Starting Abilities Description.Silver Weakness:
The life (or death) of a Hollow is a difficult one. As a Hollow, you are particularily vulnerable to silver, and often to other superstitions.
Your Quest Master may add extra superstitions you could be sensitive to, such as copper wind chimes, saffron ash or black salt circles.
